scope: FIRST independent comparison of the opened original Figure 248 and only its layout-recovery frozen final bitmap. No earlier Figure 248 bitmap opened, no Figure 246/249 reopen or repeated text review.

independentSourceInventory.sourceFact: Long vertical wire with upward current arrow through two coaxial circular traces, seen obliquely as two nested ellipses.
Four two-ended suspended needles on the outer trace: upper left, upper right, lower left and lower right. Two more on the inner trace: upper left and lower right. No radial-spoke needles.
Separate lower screw/hand-crank with shaft, threaded region, horizontal handle, upward advance arrow and curved turn arrow.
No printed N, S, I or B and no numerical radii, lengths or angles are given.

sourceFidelity.reason: The current final preserves both traces, all six source-position needles and their two-tone directions, all six suspension strands, upward current and the separate screw mnemonic. Smooth traces, changed drawing proportions, I, selected N/S and B are justified instructional normalization/additions, not alleged original labels or measurements.

worldSpaceGeometry.basis: Derived from the actual frozen spec paths and points, then compared to the opened source/final. Board coordinates are y-up; their SVG screen y is 600 minus board y. Unflatten the field plane by world X = board x - 320 and world Y = (board y - 355)/0.4, with +Z along the upward wire.
worldSpaceGeometry.circlePlaneNormal: +Z, physically parallel to the wire; the plane itself is perpendicular to the wire.
worldSpaceGeometry.currentConvention: Positive conventional current along +Z, not electron motion.
worldSpaceGeometry.expectedFieldDirection: +Z cross the radial vector, counterclockwise when viewed from +Z toward the field plane.
worldSpaceGeometry.selectedPoleAndB: The selected light S tip to dark N tip has the same positive tangent sense as the separately translated B arrow. N/S placement is clear and does not swap the ends. A positive dot product is checked, not only the native parallel assertion, which alone would also allow an antiparallel arrow.
worldSpaceGeometry.screw: The advance arrow is +Z. The rotation curve runs in the positive winding sense after its 70-by-26 projected ellipse is lifted into the same right-handed horizontal plane. The final arrow continues the curve in that sense; its head matches the curve endpoint to printed-path precision. Increasing turn phase of the small helical thread increases shaft height. No apparent ellipse/shaft screen right angle is used as physical proof.
worldSpaceGeometry.nativeAssertionCoverageLimitation: Native connects/collinear/parallel guards do not themselves enforce all circle-membership, lifted tangency or screw handedness relationships. Independent numeric checks establish those facts for these bound bytes; this is not a claim that arbitrary future edits remain covered.

SCI.reason: Conventional upward current, circular rather than radial field directions, all tangential needles, the selected S-to-N/B sign and the screw advance/turn sign are consistent in world space. No new scientific source ambiguity was observed for this figure.
